title: FleetPulse alert webhook payload v1
description: POST <FP_SINK_URL> (default http://sink:8080/webhooks/alerts). Headers: Content-Type: application/json, Idempotency-Key: <idempotencyKey>, traceparent (W3C, when the source span was sampled). At-least-once: receivers dedupe on idempotencyKey. Per alert, the sender delivers transitions in alertVersion order (next row not attempted until the previous one is DELIVERED or DEAD); receivers may also order by alertVersion. Response handling: 2xx = delivered; 408, 429, 5xx, timeout, connection error = retry with exponential backoff (1 s doubling to a 30 s cap, 20 attempts); any other 4xx = permanent, row goes DEAD at once (counted, kept).

idempotencyKey.description: alert-<alertId>-<transition>. Stable across retries; each transition happens at most once per alert.

alertVersion.description: 1 = opened, +1 per later transition. Receiver keeps the highest seen.

backfilled.description: true when the alert was opened from a replayed (buffered) sample, e.g. a fault that started and ended while the device was disconnected. Same value on every transition of the alert.

triggerEventId.description: Event that opened the alert (null for alerts opened by the offline sweep or state-rule reopen).

conditionStartedEventTime.description: Device event_time of the first breaching sample (device clock, may be skewed). Null for state rules opened by the sweep.
